title: Accountant cum Admin
description:
**Tutti Trading India Pvt. Ltd** 
 is looking for a
 **responsible, detail\-oriented, and organized Accountant cum Admin** 
 to join our team in
 **Kozhikode, Kerala** 
 .
 



 This is a great opportunity for a professional with
 **2–3 years of experience** 
 who can independently manage day\-to\-day accounting activities while also supporting administrative and office operations.
 



  





**Accountant cum Admin** 




 📍
 **Location:** 
 Kozhikode, Kerala
 



 💼
 **Experience:** 
 2–3 Years
 



 💰
 **Salary:** 
 ₹18,000 – ₹25,000 per month
 



 👤
 **Vacancies:** 
 1
 



 📅
 **Joining:** 
 Immediate joiners preferred
 



  





 We are looking for professionals who are organized, accountable, and capable of contributing to a professional and growing work environment.
 



  





 📌 Job Summary
 



  





 The
 **Accountant cum Admin** 
 will be responsible for handling routine accounting and financial activities along with administrative and office coordination responsibilities.
 



 The ideal candidate should have good knowledge of accounting procedures, strong Excel skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple tasks efficiently.
 



 💼 Key Responsibilities
 



  





**Accounting \& Finance** 



* Manage day\-to\-day accounting transactions and financial records.
* Prepare and maintain
 **sales and purchase invoices** 
 .
* Handle
 **accounts receivable and accounts payable** 
 .
* Record and verify payments, receipts, expenses, and other financial transactions.
* Maintain proper accounting documentation and supporting records.
* Assist with
 **bank reconciliation** 
 and regular checking of bank transactions.
* Support preparation of
 **MIS reports and financial statements** 
 .
* Monitor outstanding receivables and payables.
* Assist management with accounting\-related reports and information.
* Coordinate with suppliers and customers regarding invoices and payment\-related matters.
* Ensure accounting records are accurate, complete, and up to date.



  





**🗂️ Administration \& Office Operations** 



* Handle day\-to\-day administrative and office coordination activities.
* Maintain company records, documents, files, and databases.
* Coordinate with internal teams, management, suppliers, and other stakeholders.
* Assist with procurement and routine office requirements.
* Maintain office\-related documentation and records.
* Support management in scheduling, coordination, and general administrative activities.
* Handle multiple administrative tasks while ensuring deadlines are met.
* Assist in maintaining smooth day\-to\-day office operations.



**🎯 Requirements** 



* **2–3 years of relevant experience** 
 in accounting and administration.
* Degree/Diploma in
 **Accounting, Finance, Commerce, Business Administration** 
 , or a related field preferred.
* Good understanding of basic accounting principles and procedures.
* Hands\-on experience with
 **Tally, Zoho Books, or similar accounting software** 
 .
* Good knowledge of
 **MS Excel and MS Office** 
 .
* Ability to prepare and maintain invoices, payment records, receivables, and payables.
* Good numerical and analytical skills.
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
* Good organizational and time\-management skills.
* Strong communication and coordination skills.
* Ability to work independently and handle multiple responsibilities.
* Candidates from
 **Kozhikode** 
 are preferred.
* **Immediate joiners** 
 will be given preference.



  





**⭐ Preferred Skills** 



* Tally
* MS Excel
* MS Word
* Bank Reconciliation
* Accounts Payable \& Receivable
* Invoice Management
* MIS Reporting
* Documentation
* Office Administration
* Good communication skills
* Time management and multitasking



  





**👤 Ideal Candidate** 




 We are looking for someone who is:
 



 ✅ Accurate and detail\-oriented
 



 ✅ Responsible and trustworthy
 



 ✅ Well\-organized
 



 ✅ Good with numbers and documentation
 



 ✅ Comfortable working with Excel and accounting software
 



 ✅ Able to manage accounting as well as administrative responsibilities
 



 ✅ Proactive and willing to take ownership of assigned tasks
 



 ✅ Able to communicate effectively with colleagues, suppliers, and management
   





**📩 How to Apply** 




 Interested candidates can send their
 **updated CV/Resume** 
 to us.
 



 📞
 **Contact / WhatsApp:** 
 \+91 80860 45151
 



 Please mention
 **“Accountant cum Admin – Kozhikode”** 
 when applying.
 



**Immediate joiners are encouraged to apply.**

title: Income Auditor
description:
**Job Description**
**Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You**
 Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! As an
 **Income Auditor** 
 , you’re not just ensuring the accuracy and integrity of the hotel's financial transactions – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Here's what you'll do during a typical day:
   

  

* Ensure accurate financial records: Balance and code the previous day’s transactions, preparing daily operating sales and labor summaries
* Verify and audit transactions: Review night audit reports, ensure sales journal accuracy, and analyze all adjustments
* Reconcile banquet revenue: Audit banquet tickets and match them with banquet orders to ensure proper billing
* Monitor financial adjustments: Track and route rebates, miscellaneous charges, promotional tickets, and paid outs
* Maintain recordkeeping: File and archive financial documents in compliance with tax authority requirements
* Collaborate for success: Assist team members and other departments as needed


**Qualifications**
**What It Takes to Make the Stay**
 At Hilton, Our Core Values Define What It Takes To Succeed Here And Guide The Qualities We Look For In Every Team Member
   

  

 A passion for spreading the light and warmth of
 **Hospitality** 
 . Acting with
 **Integrity** 
 and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through
 **Leadership** 
 . A belief that
 **Teamwork** 
 drives the best outcomes. A sense of
 **Ownership** 
 and accountability. And a focus on the
 **Now** 
 , bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.
   

  

**About Us**
**Join an Award\-Winning Workplace Culture**
 At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.
   

  

 Our award\-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world\-class brands , and a company\-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.
   

  

 Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.
   

  

 Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.
